title: One market-closed wording on every screen and gate (G-11-3, wording fix under ADR-177)
reference_behaviour: The product uses a single wording for the age of prices, a clock line on the builder, and never a second variant for the same state.
ours: Three wordings exist: the banner, the gate text Market closed - last price {time}, and AC-7's old text. ADR-177 makes the banner wording the only one; row 11's fix round builds it.
